text:
Rae (marketing PM): PulseAI case draft in Drive. Need legal review + customer signoff by Thu noon to hit next Monday's launch. Also planning a joint webinar May 28  who owns registration + landing page?

Omar (producer): I can take the landing page and hero asset. Timeline: hero quote by Wed EOD, transcript cleanup Thu AM, design Thurs.

Priya (legal): Paste exact quote copy. Any percentages need backup or we soften the language. Confirm logo/media release.

Rae (marketing PM): Two quote options below. Short hero and long variant.

Omar (producer): ```Long: "Switching to Redwood cut our per-token spend by ~60% and halved tail latency, which let us push features faster."```

Priya (legal): Flags: "~60%" and "halved" are quantitative. Either attach the benchmark appendix or change to "significantly reduced per-token spend" and "material tail-latency improvements." Also change "push features faster" -> "accelerate feature delivery."

Jules (growth): For inbound routing: create tag pulseai_launch and route demo signups to pulseai_sdr. I'll set up a two-email nurture and UTM params.

mktsys-bot: Ticket MKT-1104 created: "PulseAI case legal review + webinar setup" assigned to Omar.

Omar (producer): Short hero candidate: "PulseAI reduced inference costs and sped up rollouts with Redwood."

Priya (legal): Edit short hero: replace "sped up" -> "accelerated" and "reduced inference costs" -> "reduced inference costs" (keep). Final: "PulseAI reduced inference costs and accelerated rollouts with Redwood." Approved pending customer signoff and logo release.

Rae (marketing PM): Thanks. @Jules confirm SDR queue and opt-in language? @Omar drop final hero in Figma by Thu 9am and I'll ping PulseAI for final signoff.

Jules (growth): Confirmed pulseai_sdr queue exists. Opt-in: "By registering you agree to be contacted about Redwood products." UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=pulseai_launch

Omar (producer): Figma link: https://redwood.app/figma/pulseai-hero  will upload frames.

Priya (legal): Approved as edited. :white_check_mark: Waiting on signed media release from PulseAI.

Rae (marketing PM): Great  I'll follow up with PulseAI and post updates here when we have the signed release.
